title: Inject a control-plane failure and choose the response
description: Compare fail-closed containment with continue-first behavior. Adjust the relevant recovery control and watch evidence gaps or unsafe activity appear.

scenarios.label: One collector fails
scenarios.detail: The remaining collectors receive the full event stream for 12 minutes.

scenarios.label: Scope policy is unavailable
scenarios.detail: New actions cannot be matched to the active engagement for 10 minutes.

scenarios.label: Operator credential is exposed
scenarios.detail: A valid operator session must be revoked and reconciled during a 20-minute incident.

scenarios.label: Evidence store is unavailable
scenarios.detail: Collectors must buffer the full event stream locally for 10 minutes.

responsePolicies.label: Contain first
responsePolicies.detail: Deny unvalidated work, stop exposed sessions, and preserve evidence before resuming.

responsePolicies.label: Continue first
responsePolicies.detail: Keep the exercise running while operators investigate and recover controls.
